title: BDGFish
ingredients: 1 (1-lb) piece grouper or red snapper fillet (3/4 inch thick), skinned and halved crosswise
directions: Working off heat (cool pan), put 1 tablespoon oil in a 10-inch nonstick skillet and add fish, turning to coat with oil on both sides. Arrange fish skinned sides down and sprinkle with salt and pepper.

Toss together tomato, garlic, basil, remaining tablespoon oil, and salt and pepper to taste in a small bowl, then mound on top of fish. Cover skillet with a tight-fitting lid and cook fish over moderately high heat until just cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Put fish on serving platter and reduce the pan sauce for a minute, maybe with white wine, or champagne, or vermouth. Pour on fish and serve!
